description: This file defines a final class ReadData that models the <read-data> element in the entity configuration. It contains a constructor that processes an XML element to extract the 'reader-name' attribute and provides a getter method for it.

classes.name: ReadData
classes.description: A thread-safe, final class that models the <read-data> element in the entity configuration, encapsulating the 'reader-name' attribute.

methods.name: ReadData
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ReadData object by extracting the 'reader-name' attribute from the provided XML element, throwing an exception if the attribute is empty.

methods.name: getReaderName
methods.description: Returns the value of the 'reader-name' attribute stored in this ReadData instance.
